expectations.text: The agent uses desloppify (not just generic lint/review) to scan
expectations.evidence: Installed desloppify, ran desloppify scan --path ., used its scoring framework

expectations.text: A Python venv is created for desloppify
desloppify scan is run against the codebase
The agent communicates findings to the user in plain language
expectations.evidence: Explained scores clearly, noted no source code to scan, described subjective dimensions

expectations.text: The agent suggests concrete next steps for fixing issues
expectations.evidence: Suggested: write source code, then rescan. Pre-commit hook installed for ongoing monitoring.
